name: web-pink-grid-transmission-receipt-success-card-with-lime-share-button
title: Pink Grid Transmission Receipt Success Card
whatItIs: A tall pink graph-paper card with a black 'Network Success' label tag, a round white icon holding a lime envelope, a light 'RECORD SAVED' heading, terminal-style confirmation lines, a destination field and a lime SHARE ON X pill with a black underlay, beside a manifesto section.
whatItMeans: Framing a form submission as a system receipt makes a small moment memorable, and the grid paper feels like a printout.
techniques: Round icon badge with a hard shadow
Label tag tilted over the card corner
Lime candy button for the next step

vocabulary.definition: The screen shown after an action completes.
A grid pattern used as a background.
Text laid out like a printed transaction slip.
